proposedRefreshGuardrails.identity: Namespace stable requisition/posting IDs by ATS provider and employer; do not merge unrelated employers by bare ID
proposedRefreshGuardrails.pagination: Verify a complete scan of the same board and filter scope before reconciliation
proposedRefreshGuardrails.closures: Only explicit employer closure or absence from a complete successful same-scope snapshot; do not close records after timeouts, 403, 429, 5xx, schema changes or partial pagination
proposedRefreshGuardrails.history: Preserve firstSeenAt, lastSeenAt and closedAt; allow a previously closed job to reopen if it reappears
proposedRefreshGuardrails.failure: Fail explicitly and preserve the last known-good dataset
proposedRefreshGuardrails.rateLimits: Bound concurrency, respect Retry-After, and avoid bypassing bot protection
proposedRefreshGuardrails.scope: These two vendor-company boards alone do not cover platform-development jobs at banks, consultancies or other employers
